recovery_regressions: Missing preview ACK settles from matching completion/error/cancellation without releasing the old ACK.
Read-only status recovers a lost completion push, with or without a missing ACK.
Late ACKs and same-revision computing pushes cannot replace a newer preview.
Only one read-only status request is in flight; timeout shows connection attention without restarting geometry.
A completed push clears connection attention, and Cancel retires polling.
Old status responses cannot affect a replacement session; recovery never recomputes or commits.

limits: The one-time native check reopens only the owned product palette and verifies its ready handshake and native state preservation.
Loss and timing regressions use the actual browser controller with a simulated message boundary; they are separate from manual CEF clicking.
